title: Reticle Inspection - Edge Placement Error Detection on Zeta-20
subtitle: Post-CMP Quality Validation for 65nm Node Manufacturing
author: David Okafor

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the Zeta-20 system to detect and classify Edge Placement Error defects during post-cmp inspection at the 65nm technology node. The test is conducted at Hsinchu Fab 15 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 200mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Edge Placement Error defects that are critical to yield at the 65nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the Zeta-20 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: Zeta-20
- Inspection Type: Reticle Inspection
- Target Defect: Edge Placement Error
- Process Step: Post-CMP
- Wafer Size: 200mm
- Technology Node: 65nm
- Fab Location: Hsinchu Fab 15

This test case applies to all Zeta-20 systems deployed at Hsinchu Fab 15 for post-cmp monitoring in the 65nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: Zeta-20
Software Version: v10.0.582
Recipe: RETICLE_INSPECTION_65nm_POST_CMP
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: Medium (185 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.5μm
Edge Exclusion: 2mm
Sampling Plan: 21-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the Zeta-20 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Reticle Inspection' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Edge Placement Error defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 65nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 105 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 99% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.8% for Reticle Inspection
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.97 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-06-05
Wafers Tested: 48
Total Defects Found: 1666
Defect Density: 530.3 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 7.7%
Capture Rate: 85.9%
Test Duration: 111 minutes
System Uptime: 99.4%

Result Classification: NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Zeta-20 demonstrated below-target performance in detecting Edge Placement Error at the 65nm node.

b) The capture rate requires optimization of the detection algorithm.

c) Nuisance rate exceeds the target threshold; recipe tuning is recommended.

d) Cross-correlation with the reference SEM confirmed classification accuracy.

e) Recipe portability between systems at this fab was confirmed.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Review edge-zone detection parameters for optimization.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Monitor performance over next 30 production days.
